chapter: Bix, Trumbauer and the Goldkette sidemen
title: Doc Ryker takes charge of the unruly band
summary: Charlie Horvath turned discipline over to Doc Ryker, a teetotaler and former scoutmaster, who treated the band like Boy Scouts.

story.theme_name: Drink, drugs and the bandstand's casualties
story.community_name: Drugs and drink on the bandstand and the road

blocks.x: How did your brother put up with it?
Well he used to do a lot of swearing. And that's when Doc Ryker stepped in. Now Doc was a very...He was the only one I would say who was the most
serious. He never touched a drop. Doc Ryker did not drink. And he told Charlie, let me see if I can handle these kids. So my brother turned the band over to Doc.
Yes. He knew how to discipline them. I don't know how he did it but he did it.
He told me, Doc Ryker told me that he had experience as a scoutmaster. He simply treated them like Boy Scouts.
We were talking about Tommy Dorsey and Jimmy Dorsey, you know all these people who became famous. But to him, they were just a bunch of kids.
Sure. And Doc was the only serious one there, to tell you the truth.
